description: Canonical reuse-fingerprint vectors (L0 r5 D-L0-3, R591-B-B3), digests in StructureDigestV1 version 2 form (origins as host templates under the slot rule, per-template originRef, paginationSignals, discoveredBy). fingerprint = lower-case hex sha256 over material.join('\n') encoded as UTF-8; material = sorted, de-duplicated JSON tuples [originTemplate, method, slotted template] for every template with role 'collection' AND discoveredBy 'landing'. No key name, kind, bucket or count enters the material: 'item-key-added-same', 'optional-key-marked-same' and 'empty-collection-same' hash identically to 'two-collections'; 'explore-only-ignored' drops the explore-only template; 'origin-changes' and 'template-renamed-changes' differ. There is no full fingerprint (r3 fingerprint_full deleted). validDigest=false vectors ('two-collections-reordered-refs', 'depth-two-cutoff-and-bare-array') are deliberately NOT valid V-L0 digests and are computed over the raw form. Device obligations (EXEC_RESET_2026-09-29 §3, r5 D-L0-2 rule (2), D-L0-6.2): see test/fixtures/scout/learn/admission-rules.json deviceObligations.
